entries.label: Camp Omega — jour / Side Ops
entries.scene: Camp Omega by DAY, specifically the sandy road beside the canvas tent camp and the military warehouse/watchtower compound. Preserve the official screenshots' sandy yellow-grey dirt, low off-white corrugated warehouses with red-brown shallow roofs, olive-green fence screens and chain-link, open-sided canvas tent rows in the back, narrow steel watchtower with green enclosed hut, lattice radio masts with round dishes, simple utility poles and wires, forested low hills and clear blue sky. Match the reference building shapes and restrained scale. No rain, no night lighting. Reframe only as a side-on playable lane with road spanning entire foreground; fences and tents behind, no fence obscuring foreground.
entries.prompt: Create exactly ONE wide 16:9 static fighting-game background plate for CQC, based closely on the supplied actual game screenshot references. Match the reference building shapes and restrained scale. No rain, no night lighting. Reframe only as a side-on playable lane with road spanning entire foreground; fences and tents behind, no fence obscuring foreground.
